page.overview:
Who is Outrun?

Lily, better known as Outrun, is an unintroduced minor protagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 5 and onwards. She is one of the new members of the Guardians of the Globe.

Her backstory is largely unknown, except becoming a superhero and works for the Global Defense Agency.
